name: Private screening decoys
description: Decoy orbits for private conjunction screening and the experiment that measures how well they hide a real orbit. decoys generates decoy histories from a population of real ones (independent draws, rotated copies, resampled or chained histories, or copies of the target itself). features computes rotation-invariant features of each history from its element sets (gp view) or from daily HPOP ephemeris windows (hpop view), including the distance to the nearest public object. distinguish trains a gradient-boosted tree classifier, cross-validated by target, and reports AUC, a 95 % lower bound on epsilon, and the probability that the real history scores highest of N.

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic SGP4 evaluation, seeded draws and statistics over caller-supplied histories. No host calls, threads or network access.

wildcardJustification.detail: Histories {objects: [{id, target?, role (real or decoy), generator?, cls?, t: [unix s], n: [rev/day], e, i, raan, argp, ma: [deg], bstar: [1/earth radii]}]}: SGP4 mean elements, one object per entry.

inputPorts.description: The real histories decoys are drawn from (the public catalog); each is also a target.

wildcardJustification.detail: generator (independent, rotated, resampled, chained, aligned, fleet), window [from, to) unix s, perTarget, targets [ids], donors (population or regime), neighbours, seed.

Histories {objects: [{id, target?, role (real or decoy), generator?, cls?, t: [unix s], n: [rev/day], e, i, raan, argp, ma: [deg], bstar: [1/earth radii]}]}: SGP4 mean elements, one object per entry. Plus report: counts and the drag common mode per altitude band.

outputPorts.description: Decoy histories, role decoy, target the real history each one hides.

wildcardJustification.detail: Histories {objects: [{id, target?, role (real or decoy), generator?, cls?, t: [unix s], n: [rev/day], e, i, raan, argp, ma: [deg], bstar: [1/earth radii]}]}: SGP4 mean elements, one object per entry. The hpop view reads windows: [{t, samples: [[t, x, y, z, vx, vy, vz]] (GCRF m, m/s, one orbit), end: [t, ...] (the window's state at the next window's start)}] instead of element arrays.
